related.title: Hawaiki：維修時間與不可用比例
related.titleEn: Hawaiki: repair time and unavailability fraction
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學最壞單路退出餘量至少0；100通過、120失敗；另外列出端口與登陸點共同依賴。 amitie_nminus1.csv與可搬移服務矩陣 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 10 與變更 -10 Tbit/s、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching worst single-route-loss spare must be nonnegative:100 passes and120 fails; list common port and landing dependencies separately. amitie_nminus1.csv and movable-service matrix Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 10 and changed -10 Tbit/s, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學不可用比例上限0.002；10天方案不足、4天方案通過；說明固定平均模型不含尾部與共同災害。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching unavailability limit0.002:10-day repair fails and4-day repair passes; the mean model omits tails and common disasters.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成三路各80、60、50 Tbit/s，總需求100；退出最大路，需求再增為120 Tbit/s。 名義式 (80+60+50)-80-100 = 10 Tbit/s；變更式 (80+60+50)-80-120 = -10 Tbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 枚舉三個單路退出情境，分別計剩餘能力減需求；最大容量路退出應給最小餘量。

合成平均可用期間3650天，平均維修10天；有備料情境改為4天，均非營運商維修承諾。 名義式 10/(3650+10) = 0.00273224 fraction；變更式 4/(3650+4) = 0.00109469 fraction。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 建立100個完全同長的合成週期，用停機總天數/總天數回算；區別MTBF指可用期間或含維修週期的定義。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic route capacities80,60,50 Tbit/s with100 demand; remove the largest route, then increase demand to120 Tbit/s. Nominal (80+60+50)-80-100 = 10 Tbit/s; changed (80+60+50)-80-120 = -10 Tbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate all three single-route removals and compute remaining capacity minus demand; removing the largest should give minimum spare capacity.

Synthetic mean uptime3650 days and repair10 days; a spare-parts scenario reduces repair to4 days, not an operator commitment. Nominal 10/(3650+10) = 0.00273224 fraction; changed 4/(3650+4) = 0.00109469 fraction. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Build100 identical synthetic cycles and divide total downtime by total time; clarify whether the chosen MTBF convention includes repair.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.titleEn: E91/CHSH: correlations and a Bell check

related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學點估計需S>2才符合違反條件；2.6通過、1.8不通過；正式結論仍需誤差界及明示漏洞假設。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching point estimate requiresS>2:2.6 passes and1.8 fails; a formal result still requires uncertainty bounds and loophole assumptions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成三路各80、60、50 Tbit/s，總需求100；退出最大路，需求再增為120 Tbit/s。 名義式 (80+60+50)-80-100 = 10 Tbit/s；變更式 (80+60+50)-80-120 = -10 Tbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 枚舉三個單路退出情境，分別計剩餘能力減需求；最大容量路退出應給最小餘量。

合成四關聯為0.65、0.65、0.65、−0.65；退化後0.45、0.45、0.45、−0.45。 名義式 0.65+0.65+0.65-(-0.65) = 2.6 CHSH S；變更式 0.45+0.45+0.45-(-0.45) = 1.8 CHSH S。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 從每設定同結果/異結果計數重算E=(同−異)/(同+異)；檢查每E介於−1和1且S不超過量子界2sqrt2。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic route capacities80,60,50 Tbit/s with100 demand; remove the largest route, then increase demand to120 Tbit/s. Nominal (80+60+50)-80-100 = 10 Tbit/s; changed (80+60+50)-80-120 = -10 Tbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate all three single-route removals and compute remaining capacity minus demand; removing the largest should give minimum spare capacity.

Synthetic correlations0.65,0.65,0.65,−0.65, degraded to0.45,0.45,0.45,−0.45. Nominal 0.65+0.65+0.65-(-0.65) = 2.6 CHSH S; changed 0.45+0.45+0.45-(-0.45) = 1.8 CHSH S. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: ReconstructE from same/different outcome counts; verify everyE is bounded by one andS does not exceed2sqrt2 for the intended quantum model.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
